stem_book: A thin uniform wire is bent to form the two equal sides AB and AC of triangle ABC, where AB = AC = 5 cm. The third side BC of length 6 cm is made from uniform wire of twice the density (mass per unit length) of the first. The distance of centre of mass from A is (a) 34/11 cm (b) 11/34 cm (c) 34/9 cm (d) 11/45 cm
work: altitude 4 cm; AB, AC (5λ each) at depth 2, BC (12λ) at depth 4 ⇒ d = (10λ·2 + 12λ·4)/22λ = 68/22 = 34/11 cm
